mapper.select: SELECT * FROM message_agent WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND enabled = '1' AND auto_accept = '1' AND current_active_count < max_active_count AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY current_active_count ASC, last_assigned_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE message_agent SET current_active_count = current_active_count + 1, last_assigned_time = NOW(), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND staff_id = #{staffId} AND enabled = '1' AND current_active_count < max_active_count AND del_flag = '0'

UPDATE message_agent SET current_active_count = GREATEST(current_active_count - 1, 0), version = version + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND staff_id = #{staffId} AND del_flag = '0'
